name: Empire AT-ST Film-Scale Leaf Writer
description: SDK-16 visual-only S2c joint-aware leaf writer for film-scale Patriot EXO-45 (79E4B3D2DA5E45E3), Emancipator EXO-49 (C2D449ECF7FACAB1), Lumberer EXO-51 (7B2326F6FD9C8069), and Breakthrough EXO-55 (35DBF54F016F3624), supporting up to 4 concurrent co-op walkers with pre-resolved MeshObject seqlock + negative hash filter (zero steady-state foreign-mesh ReadProcessMemory or MXCSR/TEB overhead), differential UnitManager cache, RenderHandle 1E7CD0 retirement, and fail-closed passthrough.
